Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature implementation: Quiet launch, canary window, and training runbook

Hi Samira / Derek —

Congrats again on the signature. Attached is the first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Solstice_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a paired runbook for a conservative quiet launch + canary window (QuietLaunch_Runbook.pdf). High-level asks for this week:

- Can you confirm the final list of users for the initial canary (we suggested 12 IDs on sheet "Canary 1")?
- Procurement: please confirm the billing contact and whether we need an SOW amendment before start.
- Ops: confirm whether your infra team wants an in-person handoff or a remote warroom for the canary day.

Proposed schedule (all PST):
- Week of Oct 4 — dry run with our QA + your devs (non-customer traffic)
- Oct 11 — quiet launch: 10% traffic to Redwood Dedicated, KV caching enabled, 1100–1400 PST canary window
- Oct 18 — scale to 40% and run training sessions for support and integrators

Notes on rollback / safety: the runbook includes automated fallback to the hosted variant, token-level tracing hooks, and two pre-agreed rollback triggers (error rate > 4% sustained for 5m; latency P90 > 1200ms for 10m).

Attachments: Solstice_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP/owners), QuietLaunch_Runbook.pdf (ops runbook), Training_Roster.csv (proposed attendees).

If this aligns, please reply with the confirmed canary roster and preferred warroom modality. I’ll lock dates and send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Vanessa — thanks for the docs and clear plan. Quick answers:

- Canary roster: attaching updated Training_Roster.csv with our 9 initial seats (requesting one alternate).
- Procurement: procurement@solsticebio.com is the contact — they asked for an SOW addendum referencing the go-live window; copying them on this thread now.
- Warroom: remote is fine. We’d like a 90-minute dry run with your infra lead to validate KV cache warmups and rate-limiter settings.

Two asks from product: can we postpone the 40% scale to Oct 25 instead of Oct 18? We have a compliance audit the week of Oct 18 and would rather avoid higher load that week. If that impacts Redwood ops/SLAs, let us know and we’ll adjust.

Samira Khan
Head of Integrations, Solstice Bio

Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature implementation: Quiet launch, canary window, and training runbook

Samira — remote dry run + 90m window is perfect. A few operational clarifications from our side:

- Dry run checklist (we’ll walk this in the call): prefix/KV cache warmup (scripts included in QuietLaunch_Runbook, section 2.1), tokenization edge-case tests for your 3 legacy clients, and load generator settings (we recommend a conservative ramp: 5 -> 30 RPS over 10m).
- Metrics/telemetry: we’ll share a Grafana link during the warroom (read-only). We’ll instrument the canary with two additional traces: per-route token cost and per-request KV hit-rate.
- Rollback: automated fallback will take ~30–45s to re-route traffic to hosted model; we’ll leave manual rollback as an option.

On scheduling: pushing the 40% scale to Oct 25 is fine from capacity planning — Ben will own the Oct 11 quiet launch (10% window) and Karthik will run the Oct 25 scale exercise.

Action items:
- Vanessa: send calendar invites for dry run (proposed Oct 6), quiet launch (Oct 11 1100–1400 PST), and scale (Oct 25).
- Samira: confirm the updated roster attachment and procurement SOW ask.
- Karthik: prepare the migration cutover checklist and a short pre-run checklist for your devs.

Ben Carter
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — locking the dates and next steps:

- Oct 6, 10:00–11:30 PST — Dry run (remote warroom). Calendar invite sent to internal and Solstice attendees.
- Oct 11, 11:00–14:00 PST — Quiet launch (10% traffic). Ben will post the Grafana link and we’ll monitor token cost and KV hit-rate.
- Oct 25, 09:00–12:00 PST — Scale to 40% + support training. Karthik will run the scale checklist and hand off to Laura for onboarding support training.

Procurement: we received note about the SOW addendum. Vanessa — looping in our legal ops contact (laura.bennett@redwood.ai) to coordinate the SOW wording and sign-off timeline. Procurement team, can you confirm required form and lead?

Final notes:
- I updated Solstice_MAP_v1.xlsx with owners and the confirmed roster (sheet "Canary 1").
- I’ve added a short PoC evaluation plan to QuietLaunch_Runbook.pdf (section 3) so product can capture quality regressions vs. the baseline prompt set. Please review before Oct 6.

If no objections, we’ll proceed as scheduled and use the runbook triggers for automated fallback.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
